name: Seek out SI: 7
summary: From Goldshire, Keryn Sylvius sends new rogues with a sealed package to Stormwind City. The delivery brings them before Master Mathias Shaw, who leads the crown's covert intelligence network.

sections.title: A Courier's Test
sections.body: Rogue trainer Keryn Sylvius doubts that fresh initiates look like covert agents. She gives them a sealed delivery for the capital, testing their reliability as couriers. In doing so, she quietly judges whether they might serve the realm as scouts.

sections.title: Behind Closed Doors in Old Town
sections.body: SI: 7, or Stormwind Intelligence, Section 7, works from southeastern Old Town in Stormwind City. In this worn district, Master Mathias Shaw oversees the kingdom's covert operations. He receives the package with dry skepticism, then judges whether you have the grit for real espionage.

faq.answer: SI: 7 means Stormwind Intelligence, Section 7. From its Old Town headquarters, Master Mathias Shaw leads its secret intelligence and covert operations for the Kingdom of Stormwind.
Keryn Sylvius trains rogues at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. She works with SI: 7, evaluates local recruits and sends promising scouts to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind City.

faq.q: Where is Mathias Shaw located in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw is on the upper floor of SI: 7 headquarters, in southeastern Old Town in Stormwind City, past the city's rogue trainers.

faq.q: What happens after delivering the package to Shaw?
aliases: next quest after seek out si 7
faq.answer: After you report to Mathias Shaw, he tests your rogue skills. He sends you to Jerod's Landing to steal a shipping schedule from a Defias dockmaster.

faq.q: Why does Keryn mock the player before handing over the delivery?
faq.answer: SI: 7 operatives prize competence and sharp instincts. Keryn Sylvius treats new recruits harshly to judge their temperament and see whether they have the resolve to approach Master Shaw.

angles.text: As a rogue, you enter Stormwind's foremost espionage agency, moving from back-alley tricks to royal reconnaissance.
As an Alliance member, you rely on SI: 7 to guard the realm against threats within and beyond its borders while King Varian Wrynn remains missing.
